compatibility_rules.incompatible: any other value; do not register

compatibility_rules.compatible: additive revisions only; existing ids and names retain meaning
compatibility_rules.incompatible: reused id, renamed id, or changed field layout

safe_changes: add a protobuf field with a new field number
add a new alarm id in a later catalog revision
breaking_changes: change or reuse a protobuf field number
change a field type or package/service name
change an existing alarm id, name, or packed id layout
consumer_action: Verify device-contract-v1.json and the descriptor hash before connecting; refuse mismatches without guessing.
